errors.evidence: The bars in the chart are not in a random order; they are sorted in descending order based on their percentage value.
The chart label is "Прекъсване на конкуренцията / пазара" (Disruption of competition / market), not "Прехвърляне на конкуренцията" (Transfer of competition).
The chart label is "Киберпрестъпления" (Cybercrimes). While related, "Кибератаки" (Cyberattacks) is not the exact term used on the axis.
The chart label is "Природно бедствие" (Natural disaster). The words "Промяна на" (Change of) are hallucinated and not present in the label.

This incorrectly combines and misinterprets multiple distinct categories from the chart, namely "Финансови / ликвидност", "Технологичен провал", and "Прекъсване на конкуренцията / пазара". It also incorrectly translates "провал" (failure) as "пробив" (breakthrough).
The value for the category "Неизправност" is exactly 20% on the chart, not approximately 22%.
The value for the category "Правни/регулаторни" is approximately 16% on the chart, not 20%.
The value for the category "Киберпрестъпления" is approximately 16% on the chart, not 18%.
